meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 代理容器里安装 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动向 api.vercel.com 注入 Vercel 凭据,之后代理就能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。过程中会向你要一个 Vercel 个人访问令牌。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;若 OneCLI 未就绪,会先让你运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 代理用 vercel deploy --prod 执行部署

say.text: 列出我当前的 Vercel 部署
检查一下 Vercel 的登录状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude installs the Vercel CLI inside NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials for api.vercel.com, so agents can deploy web apps to Vercel. It asks you for a Vercel personal access token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw agents to deploy web applications to Vercel; if OneCLI is missing, it tells you to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production
